task_description: Replace direct payment with a redemption code system. Admin creates one-time-use codes with token amounts. Customers redeem codes to get tokens. Add automatic tier/rank system based on render count. Add admin panel to view all code redemption history for verification purposes.

verification.summary: All PHP files pass php -l syntax checks. Review fixes applied: TYPE_REDEEM via new redeem() method, throttle on /redeem-code, DB::transaction on generateCodes, max-attempts guard on generateUniqueCode, route param renamed to {redemptionCode}, cascadeOnDelete changed to nullOnDelete, TierService wrapped in try/catch in RenderPsdJob.
